# Norstella Launches Atlas, an Agentic AI Platform Built on Biopharma’s Most Connected Data
- August 4, 2026

_New platform combines Norstella’s proprietary data assets with purpose-built AI agents to deliver decision-ready outputs across the drug development lifecycle_

**New York – August 4, 2026**: [Norstella](https://www.norstella.com/), the connected data foundation the life sciences industry relies on, today launched [Norstella Atlas](https://ai.norstella.com/), an agentic AI platform that turns that foundation into finished, decision-ready work.

Atlas launched August 4, drawing on Norstella data ranging from clinical trials and drug pipelines to market access to real-world patient data.
